ce_bugs.text: Migration interpolates raw site-setting host text into SQL, raising on values needing escaping and wedging the upgrade

destroy action calls .destroy on possibly-nil record, raising NoMethodError (500) instead of 404
PUT /customize/embedding update action is a no-op that re-renders serializer without persisting, falsely reporting success
save_host assumes params[:embeddable_host] exists, causing NoMethodError instead of 400 for missing params
Migration interpolates host values directly into raw SQL INSERT; single quotes break the migration
Fabricator file contents swapped: category_fabricator.rb defines :embeddable_host and vice versa
Migration builds SQL via string interpolation of unvalidated site setting values, allowing quote breakage/injection; should use sanitized/bound params
record_for_host port/case mismatch: hosts saved with a port (permitted by validation regex) can never match URI(referer).host, breaking embedding for those sites
Migration interpolates unsanitized site setting values into SQL, breaking on quotes and storing hosts with http:// prefixes raw so record_for_host never matches them post-upgrade
Migration raises NoMethodError via [0]['id'] when embed_category/uncategorized_category_id rows are absent from site_settings
before_validation calls sub! on nil host when host is blank, producing 500 instead of validation error
Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category setting is unset ('' default), since JOIN returns no rows and execute(...)[0] is nil before the fallback check
Backfilled hosts bypass EmbeddableHost validation and normalization; stored values with paths/schemes will never match record_for_host, silently breaking embedding after upgrade
Migration raises NoMethodError when the embed_category setting lookup returns no matching row (nil [0]['id']), halting the deploy
Migration interpolates host values directly into SQL, so legacy values containing quotes break the migration and it's a raw injection vector from previously-admin-controlled data
Admin::EmbeddingController#update is a fake save: it does nothing except re-serialize the unchanged OpenStruct, so the client reports 'saved' while persisting nothing
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController update/destroy crash with 500 (NoMethodError on nil) for missing/already-deleted ids instead of graceful 404
record_for_host compares URI(host).host (port stripped) against stored hosts that may include a port, so records like example.com:8080 can never match any referer
Store _hydrateEmbedded unconditionally deletes xxx_ids keys even when the sub-type can't be resolved, producing arrays of undefined and destroying original ids
EmbeddableHost before_validation crashes with NoMethodError on nil host (e.g. API POST missing host param) instead of returning a validation error
destroyRecord/deleteHost has no error handling: on failure the row stays with no user feedback (no popupAjaxError)

mrv_findings.text: Fabricator file contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb contains the embeddable_host fabricator while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains category fabricators, breaking file naming conventions and tooling that expects category fabricators in their own file

Missing frontend model files: store.find('embedding') and store.createRecord('embeddable-host') reference models with no defined model files, causing the /admin/customize/embedding route to fail on model load

Migration uses unescaped string interpolation into raw SQL: interpolating embeddable_hosts setting values into INSERT statements raises SQL syntax errors for values containing quotes, leaving the migration half-applied
Serializer uses embed: :ids only, so the client-side hydration of embeddable_host ids may fail if the hosts are not sideloaded in the payload, resulting in an empty hosts table

Controller returns an OpenStruct model with non-numeric id 'default', which may produce invalid record-level update URLs (e.g. /admin/customize/embedding/default) that 404 since only put 'customize/embedding' is registered
spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb and category_fabricator.rb contents are swapped, breaking Fabricate(:category) and Fabricate(:embeddable_host) across the suite
Admin::EmbeddingController#update is a no-op that re-serializes without persisting, while the frontend calls it as a save, giving false success
EmbeddingSerializer uses has_many :embeddable_hosts, embed: :ids but the client template iterates full host objects, yielding an empty/broken host table
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController update/destroy do not handle unknown ids, causing NoMethodError -> 500 on stale/invalid ids
Deleting a category leaves dangling embeddable_hosts rows (null: false category_id, no dependent or FK), and TopicEmbed.import can assign a deleted category id to new topics
No test coverage for new controller behavior (create/update/destroy, validation, migration backfill), including untested raw SQL interpolation of legacy setting values in the migration

category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contents are swapped — embeddable host fabricator is in category_fabricator.rb and all category fabricators are in embeddable_host_fabricator.rb, a misleading accidental file swap
Store.js _hydrateEmbedded generalized to support *_ids arrays (plural hydration) plus new colors model and fruit fixture changes — unrelated store feature smuggled into the embedding PR, scope drift
hydrated || [] guard in _hydrateEmbedded silently swallows _lookupSubType failures
EmbeddingController#update renders the serializer but changes nothing — dead write path: PUT route and client saveChanges() imply persistence semantics that don't exist

Migration imports legacy embeddable_hosts setting values verbatim without stripping scheme/path, so hosts like 'https://example.com/1234' will never match record_for_host and previously-allowed hosts silently stop embedding after upgrade
Migration uses raw string interpolation of site_settings.value into SQL INSERT without escaping — a legacy value containing a quote corrupts the migration or injects SQL

topic.rb expandable_first_post? silently drops the SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? host gate, loosening the invariant without stated intent, and the updated spec hides rather than tests the change
SQL injection via interpolated setting values in migration (raw "VALUES ('#{h}', ...)") allows quotes/backslashes to break or inject SQL

Migration inserts raw host values without before_validation normalization, storing scheme+path that record_for_host's lower(host) comparison never matches, so migrated hosts silently stop allowing embedding after upgrade
No UNIQUE index on host column allows duplicate rows, making record_for_host's .first pick nondeterministic
lower(host) = ? lookup has no index (plain or functional) and runs on every embed request, causing non-sargable full table scans
category_id has no FK or index, allowing orphan rows pointing at deleted categories

Case and port mismatch: validation regex /i saves hosts like EvilTrout.com:8080 with case and port preserved, but record_for_host queries lower(host) = uri.host (downcased, port excluded), so such hosts never match and embedding silently fails

Admin embedding controller update action is a no-op that renders serialized data without changing anything, while client saveChanges() calls embedding.update({}) with empty props, presenting a fake-success save
Embedding serializer has_many :embeddable_hosts with embed: :ids sends only id arrays with no side-loaded host objects, so the client's host list renders empty or hydration fails
EmbeddableHostsController destroy on a nonexistent id returns nil host and calling host.destroy raises NoMethodError, returning 500 instead of 404
Client removes the embeddable host record locally regardless of destroy success, diverging UI state from the server
before_validation calls sub! on host with no presence validation, so EmbeddableHost.new.save with nil host crashes with NoMethodError instead of a validation error
No validates_uniqueness on host, allowing duplicate hosts to be stored
Embed controller dev-admin bypass lost its 'hosts not set' guard: nil referer now blocks even dev admins and the distinct 'embeddable hosts not set' error is gone, a diagnostic downgrade
category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contents are swapped, making filenames misleading

TopicEmbed fetches eh inside the transaction but it can be nil; category: eh.try(:category_id) silently drops category selection and falls back to uncategorized with no surfacing when the article URL has no matching embeddable_host row
Migration inserts hosts raw without the normalization the model applies, so hosts like 'http://example.com' or 'example.com/path' that previously worked will silently fail host_allowed? after upgrade
Migration interpolates unescaped site-setting value directly into SQL via '#{h}', risking broken migration or SQL injection and leaving table half-populated on failure
Migration matches category by s.value = c.name, which silently drops a configured embed_category if stored as an id, causing migrated hosts to fall back to Uncategorized
topic.rb expandable_first_post? no longer requires any embeddable host to be configured, an unflagged behavior change that ungates expandable first posts from allowed hosts
EmbeddingController#update and admin-embedding.js.es6 saveChanges() form a leftover no-op save path that persists nothing and should be deleted

SQL string interpolation of site-setting data (host values) into raw SQL in migration 20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, enabling arbitrary SQL execution; should use parameterized execute with bind values

Missing nil check in admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb: `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` result used without nil check in save_host and destroy, causing NoMethodError/500 on nonexistent ids

Fabricator files contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb contains Fabricator(:embeddable_host) and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains :category fabricators, breaking Fabricate(:category) calls across the suite
Only test for Admin::EmbeddableHostsController is an inheritance assertion, providing no coverage of create/update/destroy, category_id fallback, validation error path, or nil destroy crash
Only test for Admin::EmbeddingController is a subclass assertion, leaving the OpenStruct embedding, has_many serializer embed: :ids shape, and no-op update action unverified

create-pretender.js.es6 GET /fruits/:id ignores requested id returning fruits[0], and store-test 'find embedded' asserts fruit 1's color_ids while requesting fruit 2, so the test verifies the mock against itself

New frontend behavior in embeddable-host.js.es6 and admin-embedding.js.es6 (edit toggle, save() with category_id, isNew-cancel deletion, buffered rollback, save→findById(categoryId) hydration path) has zero frontend test coverage
embeddable_host_spec.rb allowed-host false test is not discriminating: doesn't cover case-sensitivity (EVILTROUT.COM) or port/path mismatches that the lower(host) SQL lookup is supposed to fix

Irreversible migration: `change` with raw `execute` statements raises ActiveRecord::IrreversibleMigration on rollback, and deleted site_settings rows are permanently lost with no export/backup step (P1)
Unescaped string interpolation of host values into INSERT SQL; host values containing single quotes break or corrupt the backfill (P2)
Backfilled rows bypass EmbeddableHost#before_validation normalization, so scheme-prefixed hosts never match in record_for_host and embeds silently stop working after deploy (P1)
category_id can be backfilled as 0 (orphaned reference) if embed_category and uncategorized_category_id lookups fail; NOT NULL column with no FK or post-check (P2)

topic_embed.rb reads per-host category_id without guarantee it's populated/valid; migrated data with scheme-prefixed hosts falls to default category, silently mis-categorizing new embedded topics (P2)
